# Hilltop Family Dentistry — Full Profile

> The way family dentistry was meant to be — your Casper, Wyoming dentist

Hilltop Family Dentistry is a family-owned dental practice in Casper, WY, led by Dr. David Gallup, DDS, Dr. Adam Milmont, DDS. We provide comprehensive care for every age — preventive, restorative, cosmetic, orthodontic, and advanced/specialty dentistry — using modern technology like CEREC same-day crowns, 3D cone-beam imaging, and laser dentistry.

- **Address:** 3090 Talon Dr., Casper, WY 82604
- **Phone:** (307) 237-1801
- **Service area:** Casper, Mills, Evansville, Bar Nunn, Glenrock, Natrona County
- **Financing:** Cherry Financing and an in-house Membership Plan
- **Insurance:** Most major dental insurance plans accepted

## General & Family Dentistry

### Dental Cleanings & Exams
Routine cleanings and comprehensive exams are the foundation of a healthy smile. At Hilltop Family Dentistry, our hygienists remove plaque and tartar, polish your teeth, and screen for early signs of decay and gum disease — so small issues are caught before they become painful or expensive.
More: https://hilltopfamilydentalwy.com/services/dental-cleanings-exams

### Dental Sealants
Sealants are a thin, protective coating painted onto the chewing surfaces of back teeth, where most cavities start. They're fast, painless, and a smart way to protect children's molars as they come in.
More: https://hilltopfamilydentalwy.com/services/dental-sealants

### Digital X-Rays
Digital X-rays give our dentists a detailed view of what's happening below the surface — between teeth, under existing fillings, and in the bone — using up to 80% less radiation than traditional film.
More: https://hilltopfamilydentalwy.com/services/digital-x-rays

### Emergency Dental Care
Toothaches and dental injuries don't wait — and neither should you. If you're in pain or have a broken or knocked-out tooth, call Hilltop right away and we'll work to see you as soon as possible.
More: https://hilltopfamilydentalwy.com/services/emergency-dental-care

### Fluoride Treatment
A quick professional fluoride treatment strengthens enamel and helps reverse the earliest stages of decay. It's one of the simplest, most effective ways to protect teeth — for kids and adults alike.
More: https://hilltopfamilydentalwy.com/services/fluoride-treatment

### Oral Cancer Screening
Every routine exam at Hilltop includes a thorough oral cancer screening. Early detection dramatically improves outcomes, so we check your lips, tongue, cheeks, and throat for any concerning changes.
More: https://hilltopfamilydentalwy.com/services/oral-cancer-screening

### Pediatric Care
From first teeth to teenage check-ups, we make dental visits positive and stress-free for kids. Our team builds healthy habits early and helps your child feel right at home in the dental chair.
More: https://hilltopfamilydentalwy.com/services/pediatric-care

### Tooth-Colored Fillings
When you have a cavity, we restore the tooth with a tooth-colored composite filling that bonds directly to your tooth and blends in naturally — no silver or mercury, and a stronger, more conservative result.
More: https://hilltopfamilydentalwy.com/services/tooth-colored-fillings

### Tooth Extractions
When a tooth is too damaged to save, a gentle extraction relieves pain and protects your other teeth. Our dentists prioritize your comfort and walk you through every tooth-replacement option afterward.
More: https://hilltopfamilydentalwy.com/services/tooth-extractions

## Restorative Dentistry

### All-on-4 Smile Restoration
All-on-4 replaces a full arch of missing or failing teeth with just four strategically placed implants — giving you a fixed, full set of beautiful teeth, often in a single day.
More: https://hilltopfamilydentalwy.com/services/all-on-4-smile-restoration

### Bone & Sinus Grafting
When the jaw has lost bone, grafting rebuilds a strong foundation so dental implants can succeed. Our dentists use proven techniques to restore bone volume and make implant treatment possible.
More: https://hilltopfamilydentalwy.com/services/bone-sinus-grafting

### CEREC Same-Day Crowns
With CEREC technology, we design, mill, and place a custom ceramic crown in a single visit — no messy impressions, no temporary crown, and no second appointment. You walk out with your permanent crown the same day.
More: https://hilltopfamilydentalwy.com/services/cerec-same-day-crowns

### Dental Bridges
A dental bridge replaces one or more missing teeth by anchoring a natural-looking replacement to the teeth or implants on either side of the gap — restoring your bite, your smile, and your confidence.
More: https://hilltopfamilydentalwy.com/services/dental-bridges

### Dental Implants
Dental implants are the gold standard for replacing missing teeth. A titanium post acts as a new tooth root and supports a custom crown that looks, feels, and functions like a natural tooth — for decades.
More: https://hilltopfamilydentalwy.com/services/dental-implants

### TeethXpress
TeethXpress is a same-day, implant-supported solution that secures a full set of teeth to dental implants — so you can leave with a stable, confident smile and get back to eating the foods you love.
More: https://hilltopfamilydentalwy.com/services/teethxpress

## Cosmetic Dentistry

### Composite Bonding
Dental bonding uses tooth-colored composite to quickly repair chips, close small gaps, and reshape teeth — often in a single visit, with little to no removal of natural tooth.
More: https://hilltopfamilydentalwy.com/services/composite-bonding

### Gum Contouring
If a 'gummy' smile or an uneven gum line bothers you, gum contouring gently reshapes the tissue to reveal more of your teeth and create a balanced, confident smile.
More: https://hilltopfamilydentalwy.com/services/gum-contouring

### Porcelain Veneers
Porcelain veneers are thin, custom shells bonded to the front of your teeth to transform their shape, color, and alignment. They're the fastest way to a complete smile makeover that still looks completely natural.
More: https://hilltopfamilydentalwy.com/services/porcelain-veneers

### Professional Teeth Whitening
Professional whitening lifts years of stains from coffee, tea, and time to brighten your smile by several shades — safely, evenly, and far more effectively than store-bought kits.
More: https://hilltopfamilydentalwy.com/services/professional-teeth-whitening

### Zoom One-Hour Whitening
Zoom in-office whitening delivers dramatic results in about an hour. It's perfect when you want a noticeably brighter smile before a wedding, reunion, or big event — fast.
More: https://hilltopfamilydentalwy.com/services/zoom-one-hour-whitening

## Orthodontics

### SureSmile Clear Aligners
SureSmile clear aligners straighten your teeth with a series of nearly invisible, removable trays — no metal brackets or wires. They're comfortable, easy to clean, and fit seamlessly into your life.
More: https://hilltopfamilydentalwy.com/services/suresmile-clear-aligners

## Advanced & Specialty Care

### 3D Cone Beam Imaging
Our in-office 3D cone beam scanner captures a complete, three-dimensional view of your teeth, nerves, and bone — essential for precise implant planning, root canals, and complex treatment.
More: https://hilltopfamilydentalwy.com/services/3d-cone-beam-imaging

### Laser Dentistry
Dental lasers let us treat gum disease and reshape tissue with remarkable precision — often with less bleeding, less discomfort, and faster healing than traditional methods.
More: https://hilltopfamilydentalwy.com/services/laser-dentistry

### Nightguards
If you grind or clench your teeth at night, a custom nightguard protects your enamel, eases jaw tension, and prevents the costly damage that grinding causes over time.
More: https://hilltopfamilydentalwy.com/services/nightguards

### Nitrous Oxide Sedation
Feeling anxious about dental work? Nitrous oxide ('laughing gas') helps you relax during treatment and wears off quickly, so you can drive yourself home afterward. It's a safe, gentle way to make any visit easier.
More: https://hilltopfamilydentalwy.com/services/nitrous-oxide-sedation

### Periodontal Treatment
Gum disease is the leading cause of tooth loss — and it's often painless until it's advanced. Our periodontal care stops the disease, restores gum health, and protects the bone that supports your teeth.
More: https://hilltopfamilydentalwy.com/services/periodontal-treatment

### Sleep Apnea Solutions
If you snore or wake up exhausted, you may have obstructive sleep apnea. Hilltop offers comfortable custom oral appliances that keep your airway open at night — a quiet, travel-friendly alternative to CPAP for many patients.
More: https://hilltopfamilydentalwy.com/services/sleep-apnea-solutions

### TMJ Treatment
Jaw pain, clicking, and headaches often trace back to the temporomandibular joint (TMJ). We diagnose the cause and provide targeted treatment — from custom appliances to bite therapy — to bring lasting relief.
More: https://hilltopfamilydentalwy.com/services/tmj-treatment
